terra.problem: “No freedom” and “fully under the control” may suggest that a slave could never make any choices. A clearer wording is that a slave was forced to serve someone and was not free to leave.

“Even though no one owns him” wrongly suggests that a person cannot be both an actual slave and a figurative slave. Also, “gives in” may sound negative, but Romans 6:16 also uses the image for obedience.
